evals.name: register-mongo
evals.prompt: The Library backend cannot resolve IMongoCollection<Author>. Wire the Mongo provider.
evals.expected_output: Combined host with registered Mongo builder.
assertions: Matches the Chronicle and Arc naming policies.

evals.name: connection
evals.prompt: Configure the Library Mongo connection using appsettings.json.
assertions: Sets Cratis:MongoDB:Server to the Mongo URI.
Sets Cratis:MongoDB:Database to the intended database.
Resolves the typed collection rather than constructing a collection name.

evals.name: known-author
evals.prompt: A stored author does not appear in the query although registration succeeded. Check the reader configuration.
evals.expected_output: Verify writer and reader placement and representation.
assertions: Compares Cratis:MongoDB:Server and Database with the document location; for tenant A the default resolver selects library+A.
Matches BSON naming and concept value representation.
